title: on a PoC box the install stops for five things only
note: basis 'shown' means shown by the card's local runs (no Docker, no GPU, stand-ins); the container rehearsal was not run by the card.

findings.claim: on a PoC box deploy/install.sh stopped at every one of its guards (each walk failure of the day was one of them); now 74 of its stop points warn, are written to deploy/site/poc-stops.jsonl, which doctor shows, and the install goes on, 37 are kept as one of the five refusals and named so, and 15 stay stops marked depends; on PRODUCTION every stop prints master's words with master's exit code
the ruling names the rehearsal mark or TB_ENV DEV and VALIDATION as a PoC box; the card counts TEST with them (looser than VALIDATION): a ruling is wanted

15 stops of install.sh stay stops because the lines after them depend on them (a command line not understood, Docker or its compose plugin, the host's python3 modules, a second installer, no settings and no terminal, the operator's no, the database, the stack's health, and the finish check, whose only refusal on a PoC box is an anchor folder that root's nightly signer would mount read-write); each waits for the integrator's ruling

18 converted points of install.sh are not driven by the PoC test: 7 whose condition is PRODUCTION, 3 whose value makes a box that cannot be told, 2 a PoC run cannot reach, 4 root's only (the tests run as a user), and 2 that cannot be forced without root (an unreadable deploy folder, a file of another owner)

the files after install.sh are not converted: deploy/box-install.sh, tools/apply_update.sh, deploy/bootstrap.sh, deploy/launcher.sh, deploy/check_host.sh, deploy/settings_guard.sh, tools/rehearsal_real.py and tools/trialbox/launch.py keep their stops (the ratchet holds each to its count); the walk's third failure (a half-done install's link refused at the start path) can still happen there
the container rehearsal (tools/rehearse_box) was not run by the card (no Docker): its new check that the rehearsal's own install lists nothing rides on CI's rehearse jobs

four install.sh stops the lane H lead listed are kept as refusals and named as one of the four, though the ruling's words do not plainly cover them: a caller's own compose override with the real servers (3), a profile not opened for the real servers, the 64 GB class and the draft 48 GB profile (2); the integrator's ruling is asked

install.sh's other readers of TB_ENV in deploy/.env (ENV-EARLY, the REHEARSAL step, the environment gate, the settings step) still take only lines that start exactly TB_ENV=, as on master; the PoC rule now reads it as compose does (review H-1 of #1396), so on a .env with an exported or blank-led TB_ENV line those readers and compose can differ; not changed by this card (outside the ruling's two places)
